title: Multi-domain FEM-BEM coupling with several impenetrable obstacles
summary: In a recent paper we have analyzed a new formulation of the coupling of finite and boundary element methods (FEM-BEM) for Helmholtz problems, involving several heterogeneous bounded subdomains and one homogeneous unbounded subdomain. This formulation, called Generalized Optimized Schwarz Method (GOSM), is substructured, that is, its unknowns are associated with the subdomains interfaces.
